title: ‘हामी’ कवितामा ध्वनि सौन्दर्य {Sound Beauty in the Poem 'Hami'}
nepali: प्रस्तुत अनुसन्धानात्मक लेख कवि भूपी शेरचनद्वारा रचित 'हामी’ गद्य कविताभित्र प्रयुक्त ध्वनि सौन्दर्यको पहिचान र विश्लेषणमा केन्द्रित रहेको छ । छ अनुच्छेद र १६० पब्क्तिमा संरचित हामी कवितालाई आनन्दवर्धनको ध्वनि सिद्घान्तका आधारमा केलाउनु नै यस अध्ययनको मूल उद्देश्य रहेको छ । पूर्वीय साहित्य सिद्घान्तमा आधारित भएर यो अध्ययनलाई वाच्यार्थ र व्यब्ग्यार्थको कोणबाट विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । कवितामा प्रयुक्त भनाइको गाम्भीर्य र ध्वनिको सुगठनलाई उक्तिवैचित्र्यका आधारमा अध्ययनको केन्द्रबिन्दु बनाइएको छ । आजको युगमा हामी उपनिवेशवादका बाछिटाबाट मुक्त हुन नसकेको यथार्थता, विश्वसमाजमा हाम्रो दुर्दशा र गर्विलो स्वाभिमानबाट स्खलित हुँदै घृणित बन्नु परेको अवस्थालाई यस अध्ययनमा ध्वनि सौन्दर्यको व्यब्ग्यार्थ भावका आधारमा केलाइएको छ । यसमा शब्द सौन्दर्य र अर्थगत आधारलाई विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । पुस्तकालयीय सन्दर्भ सामग्रीको उपयोग गरिएको यस लेखमा विशेष गरेर हामी कवितामा प्रयुक्त ध्वनि सौन्दर्यको पहिचान गर्नुलाई मुल उद्देश्य बनाइएको छ । समसामयिक विषयवस्तुलाई प्रतीकात्मक अभिव्यक्ति दिँदै प्रस्तुत कवितामा बिम्बात्मक भाव तथा व्यञ्जनात्मक ध्वनि सौन्दर्यचेत प्रतिध्वनित रहेको निष्कर्ष निकालिएको छ । {The presented research article is focused on the identification and analysis of sound beauty used in the prose poem 'Hami' written by poet Bhupi Sherchan. The main purpose of this study is to analyze the Bham poem, which is structured in six paragraphs and 160 lines, based on Anandavardhan's sound theory.Based on the Eastern literature theory, this study has been analyzed from the perspective of rhetoric and satire. The seriousness of the words used in the poem and the structure of the sound have been made the focus of the study based on the idioms. In today's era, the reality that we have not been freed from the colonialism, our plight in the world society and the situation where we have to become abominable from our proud self-respect, has been discussed in this study based on the satirical sense of sound beauty. In this, the word beauty and semantic basis are analyzed. In this article, which uses library reference materials, the main objective is to identify the sound beauty used in poetry. Giving symbolic expression to the contemporary theme, it is concluded that the symbolic expression and consonant sounds resonate aesthetically in the presented poem.}
american_english: The presented research article is focused on the identification and analysis of the sound beauty used in the prose poem titled 'Hami' written by the poet Bhupi Sherchan. The main purpose of this study was to analyse the Hami poem, which is structured in six paragraphs and 160 lines, on the basis of Anandavardhan's sound theory. Based on the theory of Eastern literature, this study was analysed from the viewpoint of rhetoric and satire. The study made the seriousness of the words used in the poem and the harmony of the sound the central focus, on the basis of the idioms. In today's era, the reality that we have not yet been able to free ourselves from the colonial rule, our plight in the world society and the situation in which we have to become abominable from our proud self-respect were examined in this study on the satirical basis of sound beauty. In this, the beauty of the words and the semantic basis were analysed. In this article, which made use of library-contextual materials, we took the identification of the sound beauty used in the poem as the main objective. Giving symbolic expression to the contemporary subject, the conclusion drawn in the presented poem is that the symbolic expression and the consonant sound resonated aesthetically.
british_english: The research paper under present consideration is centred upon the identification and analysis of the sound beauty employed in the prose poem 'Hami' composed by the poet Bhupi Sherchan. The principal aim of this study was to analyse the Hami poem, which is comprised of six paragraphs and 160 lines, on the basis of Anandavardhan's sound theory. This study was founded upon the theory of Eastern literature and was examined from the perspective of rhetoric and satire. The study focused upon the seriousness of the words used in the poem and the coherence of the sound, taking the idioms as its foundation. In the present day, the reality that we cannot yet extricate ourselves from the colonial yoke, our plight in the wider world society and the predicament of having to become abominable from our proud self-respect were examined in this study on the satirical understanding of sound beauty. In this, the beauty of the words and the semantic basis were examined. In this paper, which made use of contextual materials from the library, the identification of the sound beauty used in the poem was adopted as the principal objective. By giving symbolic expression to the contemporary theme, the conclusion reached in the presented poem was that the symbolic expression and the consonantal sounds resonated aesthetically.
